questions.question:
A question is given followed by two arguments. Decide which of the arguments is/are strong with respect to the question.

Question:

Should plastic bags be banned in India?

Arguments:

I. Yes, it is one of the sources of pollution and causes many diseases.

II. No, other alternatives of plastic may not be that colourful and attractive.
questions.solution:
• The question is about the decision of banning plastic bags in India.

 
• Argument 1 states the harmful effects of using plastic bags and thus justifies the action of banning them. It claims that plastic bags are one of the sources of pollution and they also cause many diseases. This justification is strong enough to consider banning plastic bags.
 
 
• Therefore, argument 1 is strong.
 
 
 
• Argument 2 is unreasonable. It says that other alternatives are possibly not attractive and colourful enough. However, it does not explain the significance of the colourful or attractive appearance of plastic bags. This reason is not enough to counter the decision of banning plastic bags.
 
 
• Therefore, argument 2 is not strong.
 
 

Hence, "only I is strong" is the correct answer.

questions.question: Pipe A can fill a tank in 80 min and pipe B can fill the tank in 40 min. If A and B are opened together, then in how many minutes will the tank be filled?
questions.solution:
**Given**

Pipe A can fill a tank in 80 min

Pipe B can fill a tank in 40 mi**n**

**Concept**

First find the tank filled by pipe A and B together in one minute. and then, reciprocate the answer to find the time taken by both the pipes to filled the tank

**Calculation**

Tank filled by pipe A in 1 minute = 1/80

Tank filled by pipe B in 1 minute = 1/40

Tank filled by pipe A and B in 1 minute together = (1/80) + (1/40)

⇒ (1 + 2)/80

⇒ 3/80

**∴ Tank will be filled by A and B together in 80/3 minutes. i.e. 26{2over3}**

questions.question: Champaran in Bihar was a witness to satyagrah by Mahatma Gandhi in the year ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**1917**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Champaran Satyagraha of 1917 **

 
 
• **It **was the** first civil disobedience movement **in India.
 
• Champaran district is a historic region in Bihar, India, that is now divided into the East Champaran district and the West Champaran district.
 
• Farmers in this region **revolted against the British in 1914 and 1916** over the conditions imposed on **indigo cultivation**.
 
• Earlier, similar conditions existed in Bengal, but as a result of a major uprising in 1859-61, the peasants there won their freedom from the indigo planters.
 
• Champaran is a district in the state of Bihar where tens of thousands of landless serfs, indentured labourers, and poor farmers were forced to grow indigo and other cash crops instead of food crops.
 
• The European planters had forced the peasants to grow indigo on 3/20 of the total land area (called the **tinkathia system**).
 
• When German synthetic dyes replaced indigo at the end of the nineteenth century, **European planters demanded high rents and illegal dues** from the peasants in order to maximize their profits before the peasants could switch to other crops.
 
• **The first Satyagraha movement, inspired by Mahatma Gandhi, took place in the Bihar district of Champaran in 1917. Hence, Option 1 is correct.**
 
• The Champaran Satyagraha was the first to be launched, but the term Satyagraha was first used in the **Anti-Rowlatt Act agitation**.

questions.question: 14 people buy item A while 13 people buy item B. Two people buy both items. How many people are there in all?
questions.solution:
**Given**

n(A) = 14

n(B) = 13

n(A ∩ B) = **2**

**Formula used**

n(A ∪ B) = n(A) + n(B) - n(A ∩ B)

**Calculation**

n(A ∪ B) = n(A) + n(B) - n(A ∩ B)

⇒ 14 + 13 - 2

⇒ 27 - 2

⇒ 25

**∴ There are 25 people in all.**

questions.question: Mohan is twice as good as Kamlesh and together, they finish a task in 22 days. Mohan alone can finish the task in:
questions.solution:

Mohan is twice as good as Kamlesh

Mohan and Kamlesh together complete a work in 22 days

let Mohan complete the work in x days

then, Kamlesh completes the work in 2x days

work done by Mohan and Kamlesh in 1 day = (1/x) + (1/2x)

⇒ 3x/2x² = 1/22

⇒ 3/2x = 1/22

⇒ x = (3 × 22)/2

⇒ x = 33 days

Length of panel = breadth + 10% of breadth

Area of rectangular panel = length × breadth

let the breadth of rectangular solar panel is x m

questions.question: What number has to be added to each term of 3 : 5 to make the ratio 5 : 6?
questions.solution:
**Given**

3 ∶ 5

**Calculation**

let x is added to 3 ∶ 5 to make the ratio 5 ∶ 6

(3 + x)/(5 + x) = 5/6

⇒ 6(3 + x) = 5(5 + x)

⇒ 18 + 6x = 25 + 5x

⇒ 6x - 5x = 25 - 18

⇒ x = 7

**∴ 7 has to be added to each term of 3 ∶ 5 to make the ratio 5 ∶ 6.**
